subject.title: [Bug]: When openclaw sends a link with an underscore to Feishu, the full hyperlink cannot be displayed

question: Should maintainers refresh one of the conflicting fork PR candidates, or sponsor a fresh same-repository Feishu URL-boundary fix for this issue?
rationale: The bug is valid and narrow, but related same-repository attempts are closed and the open fork candidates are conflicting, so automation should not create another duplicate branch until a maintainer chooses the fix path.

options.title: Sponsor a fresh same-repository fix
options.body: Queue or author one narrow Feishu plugin PR that fixes URL boundaries in the post payload path, preserves Markdown/code regions, and includes regression tests plus live Feishu proof.

options.title: Refresh one fork candidate
options.body: Adopt the better fork PR, resolve conflicts, then require the same focused tests and live behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Wait for contributor follow-up
options.body: Keep this issue open without a new automated branch until a contributor updates a candidate branch with mergeable code and proof.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a fresh same-repository fix
recommendation.body: Queue or author one narrow Feishu plugin PR that fixes URL boundaries in the post payload path, preserves Markdown/code regions, and includes regression tests plus live Feishu proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The current release-line Feishu send/outbound snapshot is tied to this account, making it the strongest available routing candidate for choosing the fix path.
